import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-staggered-bottleneck/tools'))
import seal_case as seal
batch=root/'tmp/staggered_bottleneck/20261103_midflow_long1800_NOA81_6';stage=root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-midflow-staggered/long1800_NOA81_6'
proof=seal.read(stage/'evidence_complete6.tar.verification.json');meta=seal.read(stage/'evidence_complete6.tar.manifest.json');window=seal.read(stage/'window_100_1800/summary.json')
assert proof['cases_verified']==proof['protocol_verified']==proof['physical_safe_count']==proof['all_completed_count']==6
assert window['extended_window_verified']==window['window_complete']==6 and window['window_start_s']==100 and window['window_end_s']==1800
assert not proof['original_paths_required'] and not proof['original_repository_reads'] and proof['archive_original_bytes_compared']
assert seal.sha(stage/'evidence_complete6.tar.gz')==meta['sha256']
records=seal.read(batch/'manifest.json');protocol=seal.read(batch/'protocol.json');assert len(records)==len(protocol['tasks'])==6
keys=lambda r:(r['candidate'],r['flow'],r['seed'],r['scenario'],r['mode'])
assert len({keys(r) for r in records})==6 and {keys(r) for r in records}=={keys(r) for r in protocol['tasks']}
mechanism=root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-midflow-staggered/diagnosis/longNOA1800_6_summary_v1/source_windows.json';m=seal.read(mechanism);mi={r['case_dir']:r for r in m['cases']};assert len(mi)==6 and m['window_s']==[100.,1800.]
out=stage/'raw_pruning';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False);index=[]
for r in records:
    assert r['candidate']=='S' and r['flow'] in (1500.,1750.,2000.) and r['seed'] in (81,82) and r['scenario']=='lane_drop' and r['mode']=='noa'
    assert r['safe'] is True and r['all_completed'] is True and r['status']=='drained' and r['returncode']==0 and r['seal_status']=='verified'
    folder=Path(r['evidence_dir']);saved=seal.read(folder/'seal.json');seal.verify(folder,False)
    assert mi[r['run_dir']]['window_complete'] and mi[r['run_dir']]['positions_sha256']==saved['originals']['positions.jsonl.gz']['sha256']
    for name,e in saved['originals'].items():
        p=Path(r['run_dir'])/name
        assert not e.get('missing') and p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size==e['bytes'] and seal.sha(p)==e['sha256']
    index.append(dict(candidate=r['candidate'],flow=r['flow'],seed=r['seed'],scenario=r['scenario'],mode=r['mode'],run_dir=r['run_dir'],evidence_dir=r['evidence_dir'],keep_full_raw=r['seed']==81,originals=saved['originals']))
assert sum(r['keep_full_raw'] for r in index)==3
seal.write(out/'raw_index_before_pruning.json',index);(out/'mechanism_source_windows.json').write_bytes(mechanism.read_bytes())
changes=[]
for r in index:
    if r['keep_full_raw']:
        changes.append({**r,'deleted':[],'bytes_released':0});continue
    changed=seal.prune_raw(Path(r['run_dir']),batch,r['originals'],verified=True)
    assert set(changed['deleted'])==set(seal.RAW_FILES);seal.verify(Path(r['evidence_dir']),False);changes.append({**r,**changed})
for r in index:
    for name,e in r['originals'].items():
        p=Path(r['run_dir'])/name
        assert (p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size==e['bytes'] and seal.sha(p)==e['sha256']) if r['keep_full_raw'] else not p.exists()
result=dict(cases=changes,pruned_successful_cases=3,retained_full_raw_cases=3,bytes_released=sum(r['bytes_released'] for r in changes),archive_sha256=meta['sha256'],extended_window_and_mechanism_verified_cases=6,display_scope='First fixed seed81, all three flows; independent of traffic outcomes',only_exact_seed82_success_raw_pruned=True,no_recursive_delete=True,failed_cases_pruned=0,original_manifest_and_seals_unchanged=True,old_batches_untouched=True)
seal.write(out/'pruning_verification.json',result);print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='cases'}))
